summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two private placement issuances of Class A common stock. On May 22 and May 25, 2026, the Company entered into securities purchase agreements with Brown Stone Capital Ltd. and EEME Energy SPV I, LLC, respectively, to issue 13,333,340 shares each at $0.15 per share, raising aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $4 million. The shares are unregistered, relying on exemptions under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b) of Regulation D; each investor represented accredited status. The filing is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation. No deal terms like price per share or premium are applicable; the transaction is a standard private placement.
